task.summary: Produce a test-only 1v1 gift wish-list draft with independently reviewable recipient and sender capabilities
task.rationale: The request crosses two user roles, multiple states, product specification, prototype behavior, and independent acceptance outcomes

items.handling: Keep values TBD and use non-committal prototype placeholders; resolve before production implementation
Limit the draft to the two stated roles and mark the production permission policy TBD

items.decision: Payment, refund, cancellation, and delivery behavior
items.handling: Prototype only initiation; do not claim settlement or delivery behavior

items.decision: Privacy, safety, age, and regional restrictions
items.handling: Mark compliance behavior TBD and exclude production rollout
Stop the prototype at a successful initiation state and mark downstream effects TBD

confirmedFacts: The work is a Sandbox-only draft
The recipient manages a wish list
The sender views the list in a 1v1 context and initiates a gift send

tickets.outcome: Recipient can view available gifts and add or remove wish-list items
acceptance: Adding an available gift makes it visible in the recipient wish list
Removing a gift removes it from the visible wish list
Loading, empty, error, disabled, and success states are inspectable
